name: pasted-email
description: Carol pastes an email with three sections, each with what we need to do (#335). The mixer and sensor actions are separate work in acme-co/web and acme-co/api, so the run gives the paste a second topic with also_topic and proposes each, quoting only its part. The labels action belongs with the mixer, so it's a checklist item on that issue.

repos.description: The customer web app: dashboard, login, reports
The public REST API and the billing service behind it

events.text:
Notes from the vendor email:
Mixer: the cleaning cycle runs twice. OURS: we need to show one cycle in the dashboard.
Labels: the cycle label is unclear. OURS: we need to rename it to Cleaning.
Sensor timing: readings arrive late. OURS: we need the API to send them every second.

arguments.title: Show one mixer cleaning cycle in the dashboard
arguments.body:
## Problem
The dashboard shows the mixer's cleaning cycle twice.

## Proposal
Show one cycle, and rename its label to Cleaning.

## Suggested approach
Drafted by the agent from the discussion; adjust before starting.

1. Show the cleaning cycle once.
2. Rename the cycle label.

## Acceptance
- [ ] The dashboard shows one cleaning cycle
- [ ] The cycle label reads Cleaning

arguments.title: Send sensor readings every second
arguments.body:
## Problem
Sensor readings arrive late.

## Proposal
Have the API send readings every second.

## Suggested approach
Drafted by the agent from the discussion; adjust before starting.

1. Send each reading as it arrives, at least once a second.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Readings arrive every second

issues.title: Password reset email arrives late
issues.body: Reset emails take up to an hour to arrive.

issues.title: Dashboard loads slowly with many widgets
issues.body: With more than twenty widgets the dashboard takes ten seconds to load.

issues.title: Keyboard shortcuts for the reports page
issues.body: Let people move between reports with the arrow keys.

issues.title: Rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
issues.body: Clients cannot tell when to retry.

issues.title: Webhook retries ignore the backoff setting
issues.body: Retries fire every second regardless of the configured backoff.

expected.summary: One pasted message feeds two topics, with one create_issue proposal each, in acme-co/web and acme-co/api.
